verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly claim support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, plus hardware plugins (TPUs, Gaudi, Ascend, etc.) with vendor-specific kernels implied by hardware-specific plugin architecture, and marketing tagline states 'Run any model on any hardware.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of AMD/other-vendor kernel performance and no first-party detail on which specific vendor kernels (e.g., ROCm-specific) are used beyond the plugin list.
